description: Total Waste Generated by Type and Recycled is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset shows the total amount of waste recycled along with the breakdown of non-hazardous and hazardous waste generated. It supports monitoring of waste management and recycling performance. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are waste, recycling, hazardous, environment. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste-facility and collection planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
